role: Strategy-type-specific PM style projection for the short-horizon crude-oil calendar-spread strategy. It derives one dedicated style radar from an appointed oil strategy-research person without introducing a second person, an alpha score, or direct execution/risk authority.

style_dimensions.curve_continuation_reversion: preference for continuation versus mean reversion in the main-minus-adjacent-next dollar spread
style_dimensions.forecast_vs_visible_curve: relative reliance on published two-leg forecast spread change versus currently visible curve evidence
style_dimensions.dislocation_selectivity: preference for waiting for larger spread dislocations versus participating broadly
style_dimensions.capital_deployment: normal willingness to deploy committee-authorized capital into this strategy
style_dimensions.adjustment_tempo: normal speed for moving spread exposure toward a new strategy target
style_dimensions.rebalance_activity: normal willingness to refresh or rebalance spread exposure when the thesis remains active
style_dimensions.holding_patience: persistence of an existing spread position when the desired target shrinks but does not reverse
style_dimensions.forecast_horizon: preference within the short-horizon two-leg forecast window

projection_invariants: the dedicated radar is derived from the already appointed oil strategy-research person and never creates a second appointment
the default compatibility appointment projects to exactly 50 on every dedicated style dimension
generated-personnel projections are deterministic functions of the source profile plus a strategy-specific idiosyncratic stream
strategy-specific idiosyncrasy may make directional and calendar-spread preferences differ for the same person but does not make them unrelated
all dedicated style scores remain between the registered floor and ceiling
no dedicated style dimension is an investment-quality, alpha or capability score
the dedicated radar cannot read hidden future prices, forecast truth or realized PnL
runtime_invariants: curve_continuation_reversion, dislocation_selectivity, capital_deployment, adjustment_tempo, rebalance_activity, holding_patience and forecast_horizon adapt into the existing strategy-research parameter mapping
forecast_vs_visible_curve is calendar-spread-specific and changes only the mixture of already computed forecast-spread and visible-curve signal components
forecast_vs_visible_curve cannot alter the component signs, read future prices or bypass the signal deadband
near-month focus is intentionally not a calendar-spread style axis because v1 requires an exact one-to-one real-leg target
construction capability remains owned by oil_strategy_research_v2 and is not duplicated into the dedicated style radar
execution ability remains owned by oil_execution_desk_v2 and strategy risk remains owned by the calendar-spread risk adapter
